title: Integrate AWS Lambda with Amazon Bedrock
description: Deploy a Lambda function that sends prompts to Anthropic Claude in Amazon Bedrock with the Converse API.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern builds a container image, pushes it to Amazon ECR and deploys it as an AWS Lambda function in your VPC.
The function sends the prompt it receives to Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 with the Amazon Bedrock Converse API, through the global cross-Region inference profile, and returns the answer.
Set the bedrock_foundation_model variable to use another model that has a global inference profile.
